breaking.change: The GPU's culling and scatter counts stay on the GPU until a probe call reads them, instead of being read back every frame. Natively state().timings.triangles, dump_render's counts and expect:timings:triangles report the last frame's own counts, as before. On the web the call asks for the next frame's: the first state() or dump_render after it reports them, and one before any read reports triangles without the GPU-culled draws and dump_render's scatter as null.
breaking.fix: On the web, read triangles or dump_render twice with a frame between (advance 1, or a frame of the host), and check countsLag in dump_render before trusting the scatter counts.
